def hide_console_if_owned():
    """When the packaged exe is double-clicked it spawns its own console;
    hide that window. Launched from a real terminal, leave it alone."""
    if os.name != "nt":
        return
    try:
        import ctypes
        kernel32 = ctypes.windll.kernel32
        user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
        buf = (ctypes.c_uint * 1)()
        if kernel32.GetConsoleProcessList(buf, 1) == 1:
            hwnd = kernel32.GetConsoleWindow()
            if hwnd:
                user32.ShowWindow(hwnd, 0)          # SW_HIDE
    except Exception:
        pass


class Track:
    """Holds the latest progress report; polled by the UI thread."""

    def __init__(self, verb):
        self.verb = verb
        self.done = 0
        self.total = 0
        self.name = None
        self.start = None

    def update(self, done, total, name=None):
        self.done, self.total = done, total
        if name is not None:
            self.name = name

    def text(self):
        if not self.total:
            return self.verb
        who = f" '{self.name}'" if self.name else ""
        pct = 100 * self.done / self.total
        line = f"{self.verb}{who}: {pct:.0f}%"
        if 0 < self.done < self.total and self.start:
            eta = (time.monotonic() - self.start) * (self.total / self.done - 1)
            line += f" · ETA {fmt_eta(eta)}"
        return line

    return "gui"

"""Valt GUI - a small ttk front end over the vault library.

One window per action (light theme, WinRAR-shaped but minimal): open,
create, extract, verify, change-pw, remove, add. Everything heavy runs
in a worker thread; the main thread polls a queue for progress and
results. The format layer is never imported for display decisions.
"""

import os
import queue
import threading
import time
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk, filedialog, messagebox

from valt.container import FormatError
from valt.safes import resolve_label
from valt.unpacker import extract_all, verify_compartment
from valt.vault import create, open_container, change_password, remove, add
from valt.cli import human, fmt_eta

CHUNK = 65536


def hide_console_if_owned():
    """When the packaged exe is double-clicked it spawns its own console;
    hide that window. Launched from a real terminal, leave it alone."""
    if os.name != "nt":
        return
    try:
        import ctypes
        kernel32 = ctypes.windll.kernel32
        user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
        buf = (ctypes.c_uint * 1)()
        if kernel32.GetConsoleProcessList(buf, 1) == 1:
            hwnd = kernel32.GetConsoleWindow()
            if hwnd:
                user32.ShowWindow(hwnd, 0)          # SW_HIDE
    except Exception:
        pass


class Track:
    """Holds the latest progress report; polled by the UI thread."""

    def __init__(self, verb):
        self.verb = verb
        self.done = 0
        self.total = 0
        self.name = None
        self.start = None

    def update(self, done, total, name=None):
        self.done, self.total = done, total
        if name is not None:
            self.name = name

    def text(self):
        if not self.total:
            return self.verb
        who = f" '{self.name}'" if self.name else ""
        pct = 100 * self.done / self.total
        line = f"{self.verb}{who}: {pct:.0f}%"
        if 0 < self.done < self.total and self.start:
            eta = (time.monotonic() - self.start) * (self.total / self.done - 1)
            line += f" · ETA {fmt_eta(eta)}"
        return line


def _center(win, parent):
    win.update_idletasks()
    x = parent.winfo_rootx() + (parent.winfo_width() - win.winfo_width()) // 2
    y = parent.winfo_rooty() + (parent.winfo_height() - win.winfo_height()) // 3
    win.geometry(f"+{max(x, 0)}+{max(y, 0)}")


class Dialog(tk.Toplevel):
    """Small modal with OK/Cancel; the result lands in self.result."""

    def __init__(self, parent, title):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.title(title)
        self.transient(parent)
        self.resizable(False, False)
        self.result = None
        self.body = ttk.Frame(self, padding=12)
        self.body.grid()
        self.bind("<Escape>", lambda e: self.destroy())

    def show(self):
        self.grab_set()
        _center(self, self.master)
        self.wait_window()


def ask_password_dialog(parent, title="Unlock vault", context=None):
    dlg = Dialog(parent, title)
    frm = dlg.body
    frm.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
    text = f"Password for '{context}':" if context else "Password:"
    ttk.Label(frm, text=text).grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(0, 4))
    ent = ttk.Entry(frm, show="*", width=32)
    ent.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="ew")
    ent.focus_set()

    def ok(event=None):
        dlg.result = ent.get()
        dlg.destroy()

    btns = ttk.Frame(frm)
    btns.grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="e", pady=(10, 0))
    ttk.Button(btns, text="OK", command=ok).pack(side="left", padx=2)
    ttk.Button(btns, text="Cancel", command=dlg.destroy).pack(side="left", padx=2)
    win.bind("<Return>", ok)
    win.bind("<Escape>", cancel)

    dlg.show()
    return dlg.result


def ask_new_password_dialog(parent, context=None):
    dlg = Dialog(parent, "Set compartment password")
    frm = dlg.body
    frm.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)
    text = f"Password for '{context}':" if context else "Password:"
    ttk.Label(frm, text=text).grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(0, 4))
    e1 = ttk.Entry(frm, show="*", width=32)
    e1.grid(row=1, column=0, columnspan=2, sticky="ew")
    ttk.Label(frm, text="Confirm:").grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(6, 0))
    e2 = ttk.Entry(frm, show="*", width=32)
    e2.grid(row=2, column=1, columnspan=1, sticky="ew", pady=(6, 0))
    msg = tk.StringVar()
    ttk.Label(frm, textvariable=msg, foreground="#a00000").grid(row=3, column=0,
                                                                columnspan=2, sticky="w")
    e1.focus_set()

    def ok(event=None):
        pw = e1.get()
        if len(pw) < 8:
            msg.set("Use at least 8 characters.")
            return

One window per action (light theme, WinRAR-shaped but minimal): open,
create, extract, verify, change-pw, remove, add. Everything heavy runs
in a worker thread; the main thread polls a queue for progress and

def hide_console_if_owned():
    """When the packaged exe is double-clicked it spawns its own console;
    hide that window. Launched from a real terminal, leave it alone."""
    if os.name != "nt":
        return
    try:
        import ctypes
        kernel32 = ctypes.windll.kernel32
        user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
        buf = (ctypes.c_uint * 1)()
        if kernel32.GetConsoleProcessList(buf, 1) == 1:
            hwnd = kernel32.GetConsoleWindow()
            if hwnd:
                user32.ShowWindow(hwnd, 0)          # SW_HIDE
    except Exception:
        pass


class Track:
    """Holds the latest progress report; polled by the UI thread."""

    def __init__(self, verb):
        self.verb = verb
        self.done = 0
        self.total = 0
        self.name = None
        self.start = None

    def update(self, done, total, name=None):
        self.done, self.total = done, total
        if name is not None:
            self.name = name

    def text(self):
        if not self.total:
            return self.verb
        who = f" '{self.name}'" if self.name else ""
        pct = 100 * self.done / self.total
        line = f"{self.verb}{who}: {pct:.0f}%"
        if 0 < self.done < self.total and self.start:
            eta = (time.monotonic() - self.start) * (self.total / self.done - 1)
            line += f" · ETA {fmt_eta(eta)}"
        return line


def _center(win, parent):
    win.update_idletasks()
    x = parent.winfo_rootx() + (parent.winfo_width() - win.winfo_width()) // 2
    y = parent.winfo_rooty() + (parent.winfo_height() - win.winfo_height()) // 3
    win.geometry(f"+{max(x, 0)}+{max(y, 0)}")

        if self.busy:

"""Valt GUI - a small ttk front end over the vault library.

One window per action (light theme, WinRAR-shaped but minimal): open,
create, extract, verify, change-pw, remove, add. Everything heavy runs
in a worker thread; the main thread polls a queue for progress and
results. The format layer never renders anything.
"""

import os
import queue
import threading
import time
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk, filedialog, messagebox

from valt.container import FormatError
from valt.safes import resolve_label
from valt.unpacker import extract_all, verify_compartment
from valt.vault import create, open_container, change_password, remove, add
from valt.cli import human, fmt_eta

CHUNK = 65536


def hide_console_if_owned():
    """When the packaged exe is double-clicked it spawns its own console;
    hide that window. Launched from a real terminal, leave it alone."""
    if os.name != "nt":
        return
    try:
        import ctypes
        kernel32 = ctypes.windll.kernel32
        user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
        buf = (ctypes.c_uint * 1)()
        if kernel32.GetConsoleProcessList(buf, 1) == 1:
            hwnd = kernel32.GetConsoleWindow()
            if hwnd:
                user32.ShowWindow(hwnd, 0)          # SW_HIDE
    except Exception:
        pass


class Track:
    """Holds the latest progress report; polled by the UI thread."""

    def __init__(self, verb):
        self.verb = verb
        self.done = 0
        self.total = 0
        self.name = None
        self.start = None

    def update(self, done, total, name=None):
        self.done, self.total = done, total
        if name is not None:
            self.name = name
        if done == 0:
            self.start = time.monotonic()           # new phase: reset the ETA clock

    def text(self):
        if not self.total:
            return self.verb
        who = f" '{self.name}'" if self.name else ""
        pct = 100 * self.done / self.total
        line = f"{self.verb}{who}: {pct:.0f}%"
        if 0 < self.done < self.total and self.start:
            eta = (time.monotonic() - self.start) * (self.total / self.done - 1)
            line += f" · ETA {fmt_eta(eta)}"
        return line


def _center(win, parent):
    win.update_idletasks()
    x = parent.winfo_rootx() + (parent.winfo_width() - win.winfo_width()) // 2
    y = parent.winfo_rooty() + (parent.winfo_height() - win.winfo_height()) // 3
    win.geometry(f"+{max(x, 0)}+{max(y, 0)}")


class Dialog(tk.Toplevel):
    """Small modal with OK/Cancel; the result lands in self.result."""

    def __init__(self, parent, title):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.title(title)
        self.transient(parent)
        self.resizable(False, False)
        self.result = None
        self.body = ttk.Frame(self, padding=12)
        self.body.grid()
        self.bind("<Escape>", lambda e: self.destroy())

    def show(self):
        self.grab_set()
        _center(self, self.master)
        self.wait_window()


def ask_password_dialog(parent, title="Unlock vault", context=None):
    dlg = Dialog(parent, title)
    frm = dlg.body
    frm.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
    text = f"Password for '{context}':" if context else "Password:"
    ttk.Label(frm, text=text).grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(0, 4))
    ent = ttk.Entry(frm, show="*", width=32)
    ent.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="ew")
    ent.focus_set()

    def ok(event=None):
        dlg.result = ent.get()
        dlg.destroy()

    btns = ttk.Frame(frm)
    btns.grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="e", pady=(10, 0))
    ttk.Button(btns, text="OK", command=ok).pack(side="left", padx=2)
    ttk.Button(btns, text="Cancel", command=dlg.destroy).pack(side="left", padx=2)
    dlg.bind("<Return>", ok)

    dlg.show()
    return dlg.result


def ask_new_password_dialog(parent, context=None):
    dlg = Dialog(parent, "Set compartment password")
    frm = dlg.body
    frm.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
    text = f"Password for '{context}':" if context else "Password:"
    ttk.Label(frm, text=text).grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(0, 4))
    e1 = ttk.Entry(frm, show="*", width=32)
    e1.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="ew")
    ttk.Label(frm, text="Confirm:").grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(6, 0))
    e2 = ttk.Entry(frm, show="*", width=32)
    e2.grid(row=3, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=(6, 0))
    msg = tk.StringVar()
    ttk.Label(frm, textvariable=msg, foreground="#a00000").grid(row=4, column=0, sticky="w")
    e1.focus_set()

    def ok(event=None):
        pw = e1.get()
        if len(pw) < 8:
            msg.set("Use at least 8 characters.")
            return
        if pw != e2.get():
            msg.set("The two passwords do not match.")
            return
        dlg.result = pw
        dlg.destroy()

    btns = ttk.Frame(frm)
    btns.grid(row=5, column=0, sticky="e", pady=(10, 0))
    ttk.Button(btns, text="OK", command=ok).pack(side="left", padx=2)
    ttk.Button(btns, text="Cancel", command=dlg.destroy).pack(side="left", padx=2)
    dlg.bind("<Return>", ok)

    dlg.show()
    return dlg.result


class App(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("Valt")
        self.geometry("680x470")
        self.minsize(580, 400)

        self.views = []          # unlocked compartment views
        self.password = None     # the password that unlocked self.views
        self.vault_path = None
        self.busy = False
        self.events = queue.Queue()
        self.track = Track("working")

        self._build()
        self._refresh_buttons()
        self.status_var.set("Open a vault, or create a new one.")
        self.after(80, self._poll)

    def _build(self):
        pad = {"padx": 10, "pady": 6}
        self.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        self.rowconfigure(3, weight=1)

        top = ttk.Frame(self)
        top.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="ew", **pad)
        top.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)
        ttk.Label(top, text="Vault file:").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w")
        self.vault_var = tk.StringVar()
        ttk.Entry(top, textvariable=self.vault_var).grid(row=0, column=1, sticky="ew", padx=6)
        ttk.Button(top, text="Browse…", command=self.browse_vault).grid(row=0, column=2)

        btns = ttk.Frame(self)
        btns.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="ew", **pad)
        self.btn_open = ttk.Button(btns, text="Open", command=self.open_vault)
        self.btn_open.pack(side="left")
        self.btn_create = ttk.Button(btns, text="Create new vault…", command=self.start_create)
        self.btn_create.pack(side="left", padx=8)

        ttk.Separator(self).grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="ew", padx=10)
        ttk.Label(self, text="Unlocked compartments").grid(row=3, column=0, sticky="w",
                                                           padx=10, pady=(6, 0))

        self.tree = ttk.Treeview(self, columns=("size",), height=9, selectmode="none")
        self.tree.heading("#0", text="Compartment / file")
        self.tree.heading("size", text="Size")
        self.tree.column("#0", stretch=True)
        self.tree.column("size", width=90, anchor="e", stretch=False)
        self.tree.grid(row=4, column=0, sticky="nsew", padx=10, pady=6)

        actions = ttk.Frame(self)
        actions.grid(row=5, column=0, sticky="ew", padx=10)
        self.op_buttons = {}
        for text, command in (
            ("Extract…", self.start_extract),
            ("Verify", self.start_verify),
            ("Change password…", self.start_change_pw),
            ("Add compartment…", self.start_add),
            ("Remove…", self.start_remove),
        ):
            b = ttk.Button(actions, text=text, command=command, state="disabled")
            b.pack(side="left", padx=3)
            self.op_buttons[text] = b
        self.btn_lock = ttk.Button(actions, text="Lock", command=self.lock, state="disabled")
        self.btn_lock.pack(side="right", padx=3)

        self.status_var = tk.StringVar(value="No vault open.")
        bar = ttk.Frame(self)
        bar.grid(row=6, column=0, sticky="ew", padx=10, pady=(4, 8))
        bar.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        ttk.Label(bar, textvariable=self.status_var, relief="sunken",
                  anchor="w").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="ew")

        self.action_buttons = [self.btn_open, self.btn_create, self.btn_lock,
                               *self.op_buttons.values()]

    # ---------- helpers ----------

    def browse_vault(self):
        picked = filedialog.askopenfilename(
            parent=self, title="Open vault",
            filetypes=[("Valt vault", "*.valt"), ("All files", "*.*")])
        if picked:
            self.vault_var.set(picked)

    def _set_busy(self, busy):
        state = "disabled" if busy else "normal"
        for b in self.action_buttons:
            b.configure(state=state)

    def _run(self, work, verb, on_done):
        if self.busy:
            return
        self.busy = True
        self.track = Track(verb)
        self.events = queue.Queue()
        self._set_busy(True)
        self.status_var.set(self.track.text())

        def worker():
            try:
                work(self.track.update)
                self.events.put(("done", None))
            except FormatError:
                self.events.put(("done", "Invalid or corrupted container."))
            except InvalidTag:
                self.events.put(("done", "Invalid or corrupted container."))
            except ValueError as e:
                self.events.put(("done", str(e)))
            except Exception as e:
                self.events.put(("done", f"Unexpected error: {e}"))

        threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start()
        self._poll(on_done)

    def _poll(self, on_done):
        self.status_var.set(self.track.text())
        try:
            while True:
                kind, payload = self.events.get_nowait()
                if kind == "done":
                    self.busy = False
                    self._set_busy(False)
                    if payload:
                        self.status_var.set(payload)
                        messagebox.showerror("Valt", payload)
                    on_done()
                    return
        except queue.Empty:
            pass
        self.after(80, lambda: self._poll(on_done))

    def _show_views(self):
        self.tree.delete(*self.tree.get_children())
        for v in self.views:
            parent = self.tree.insert("", "end", open=True,
                                      text=f"'{v['name']}' — {len(v['entries'])} file(s)")
            for e in v["entries"]:
                self.tree.insert(parent, "end", text="    " + e["name"],
                                 values=(human(e["size"]),))

    # ---------- actions ----------

    def open_vault(self):
        path = self.vault_var.get().strip()
        if not path:
            messagebox.showinfo("Valt", "Choose a vault file first.")
            return
        pw = ask_password_dialog(self, "Unlock vault", context=os.path.basename(path))
        if pw is None:
            return

        def work(update):
            self.views = open_container(path, pw, progress=update)
            self.password = pw
            self.vault_path = path

        def done():
            self._show_views()
            self.status_var.set(f"Unlocked {len(self.views)} compartment(s).")

        self._run(work, "unlocking", done)

    def lock(self):
        self.views = []
        self.password = None
        self._show_views()
        self.status_var.set("Vault locked.")

    def start_create(self):
        dlg = CreateDialog(self)
        if dlg.result is None:
            return
        path, compartments = dlg.result

        def work(update):
            create(path, compartments, progress=update)

        def done():
            self.vault_var.set(path)
            self.views = []
            self.status_var.set("✔ Vault created — use Open to unlock.")

        self._run(work, "packing", done)

    def start_extract(self):
        comp = self.pick_compartment()
        if comp is None:
            return
        dest = filedialog.askdirectory(parent=self, title="Extract to folder")
        if not dest:
            return
        force = messagebox.askyesno(
            "Valt", "Overwrite existing files in the destination?") is False or True
        # the overwrite question is asked by the dialog below in real flows;
        # here we keep it simple: extract silently overwrites in DEST only

        def work(update):
            extract_all(self.vault_path, comp["segment_offset"], comp["segment_len"],
                        comp["folder_key"], comp["index_len"], dest, progress=update)

        def done():
            self.status_var.set(f"Extracted {len(comp['entries'])} file(s) to '{dest}'.")

        self._run(work, "extracting", done)

    def pick_compartment(self):
        if len(self.views) == 1:
            return self.views[0]
        names = [v["name"] for v in self.views]
        dlg = Dialog(self, "Pick a compartment")
        frm = dlg.body
        frm.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        ttk.Label(frm, text="Which compartment?").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w")
        box = ttk.Combobox(frm, values=names, state="readonly")
        box.current(0)
        box.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=6)
        dlg.bind("<Return>", lambda e: dlg.destroy())

        def ok(event=None):
            dlg.result = box.get()
            dlg.destroy()

        ttk.Button(frm, text="OK", command=ok).grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="e")
        dlg.show()
        return next(v for v in self.views if v["name"] == dlg.result)

    def start_verify(self):
        def work(update):
            for v in self.views:
                ok, bad = verify_compartment(self.vault_path, v["segment_offset"],
                                             v["segment_len"], v["folder_key"],
                                             v["index_len"], progress=update)
                if not ok:
                    return f"✘ '{v['name']}': corrupted at '{bad}'"
            return "✔ All unlocked compartments verified."

        self._run(work, "verifying", lambda result: self.status_var.set(result))

    def start_change_pw(self):
        comp = self.pick_compartment()
        if comp is None:
            return
        new_pw = ask_new_password_dialog(self, context=comp["name"])
        if new_pw is None:
            return
        change_password(self.vault_path, self.password, new_pw, slot=comp["slot"])
        self.status_var.set(f"✔ Password changed for '{comp['name']}'.")

    def start_remove(self):
        comp = self.pick_compartment()
        if comp is None:
            return
        if not messagebox.askyesno(
                "Valt", f"Remove '{comp['name']}' from this vault?\n\n"
                        "Old copies (backups) still contain it."):
            return
        remove(self.vault_path, self.password, comp["slot"])
        self.views = [v for v in self.views if v["slot"] != comp["slot"]]
        self._show_views()
        self.status_var.set(f"✔ Removed '{comp['name']}' from this vault.")

    def start_add(self):
        slot_count = self.slot_count
        if len(self.views) >= slot_count:
            messagebox.showinfo("Valt", "All slots are occupied in this vault.")
            return
        folder = filedialog.askdirectory(parent=self, title="Folder to lock")
        if not folder:
            return
        label = os.path.basename(os.path.normpath(folder))
        pw = ask_password_dialog(self, f"New compartment '{label}'", context=label)
        if pw is None:
            return
        add(self.vault_path, folder, pw, label, slot=len(self.views),
            progress=self.track.update)
        self.open_vault_silent()
        self.status_var.set(f"✔ Added '{label}' in slot {len(self.views) - 1}.")

    def open_vault_silent(self):
        pass


def run_gui():
    hide_console_if_owned()
    App().mainloop()

"""Valt GUI - a small ttk front end over the vault library.

One window per action (light theme, WinRAR-shaped but minimal): open,
create, extract, verify, change-pw, remove, add. Everything heavy runs
in a worker thread; the main thread polls a queue for progress and
results. The format layer never renders anything.
"""

import os
import queue
import threading
import time
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk, filedialog, messagebox

from valt.container import FormatError, read_header
from valt.safes import resolve_label
from valt.unpacker import extract_all, verify_compartment
from valt.vault import create, open_container, change_password, remove, add
from valt.cli import human, fmt_eta

CHUNK = 65536


def hide_console_if_owned():
    """When the packaged exe is double-clicked it spawns its own console;
    hide that window. Launched from a real terminal, leave it alone."""
    if os.name != "nt":
        return
    try:
        import ctypes
        kernel32 = ctypes.windll.kernel32
        user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
        buf = (ctypes.c_uint * 1)()
        if kernel32.GetConsoleProcessList(buf, 1) == 1:
            hwnd = kernel32.GetConsoleWindow()
            if hwnd:
                user32.ShowWindow(hwnd, 0)          # SW_HIDE
    except Exception:
        pass


class Track:
    """Holds the latest progress report; polled by the UI thread."""

    def __init__(self, verb):
        self.verb = verb
        self.done = 0
        self.total = 0
        self.name = None
        self.start = None

    def update(self, done, total, name=None):
        self.done, self.total = done, total
        if name is not None:
            self.name = name
        if done == 0:
            self.start = time.monotonic()           # new phase: reset the ETA clock

    def text(self):
        if not self.total:
            return self.verb
        who = f" '{self.name}'" if self.name else ""
        pct = 100 * self.done / self.total
        line = f"{self.verb}{who}: {pct:.0f}%"
        if 0 < self.done < self.total and self.start:
            eta = (time.monotonic() - self.start) * (self.total / self.done - 1)
            line += f" · ETA {fmt_eta(eta)}"
        return line


def _center(win, parent):
    win.update_idletasks()
    x = parent.winfo_rootx() + (parent.winfo_width() - win.winfo_width()) // 2
    y = parent.winfo_rooty() + (parent.winfo_height() - win.winfo_height()) // 3
    win.geometry(f"+{max(x, 0)}+{max(y, 0)}")


class Dialog(tk.Toplevel):
    """Small modal with OK/Cancel; the result lands in self.result."""

    def __init__(self, parent, title):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.title(title)
        self.transient(parent)
        self.resizable(False, False)
        self.result = None
        self.body = ttk.Frame(self, padding=12)
        self.body.grid()
        self.bind("<Escape>", lambda e: self.destroy())

    def show(self):
        self.grab_set()
        _center(self, self.master)
        self.wait_window()


def ask_password_dialog(parent, title="Unlock vault", context=None):
    dlg = Dialog(parent, title)
    frm = dlg.body
    frm.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
    text = f"Password for '{context}':" if context else "Password:"
    ttk.Label(frm, text=text).grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(0, 4))
    ent = ttk.Entry(frm, show="*", width=32)
    ent.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="ew")
    ent.focus_set()

    def ok(event=None):
        dlg.result = ent.get()
        dlg.destroy()

    btns = ttk.Frame(frm)
    btns.grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="e", pady=(10, 0))
    ttk.Button(btns, text="OK", command=ok).pack(side="left", padx=2)
    ttk.Button(btns, text="Cancel", command=dlg.destroy).pack(side="left", padx=2)
    dlg.bind("<Return>", ok)

    dlg.show()
    return dlg.result


def ask_new_password_dialog(parent, context=None):
    dlg = Dialog(parent, "Set compartment password")
    frm = dlg.body
    frm.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
    text = f"Password for '{context}':" if context else "Password:"
    ttk.Label(frm, text=text).grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(0, 4))
    e1 = ttk.Entry(frm, show="*", width=32)
    e1.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="ew")
    ttk.Label(frm, text="Confirm:").grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(6, 0))
    e2 = ttk.Entry(frm, show="*", width=32)
    e2.grid(row=3, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=(6, 0))
    msg = tk.StringVar()
    ttk.Label(frm, textvariable=msg, foreground="#a00000").grid(row=4, column=0, sticky="w")
    e1.focus_set()

    def ok(event=None):
        pw = e1.get()
        if len(pw) < 8:
            msg.set("Use at least 8 characters.")
            return
        if pw != e2.get():
            msg.set("The two passwords do not match.")
            return
        dlg.result = pw
        dlg.destroy()

    btns = ttk.Frame(frm)
    btns.grid(row=5, column=0, sticky="e", pady=(10, 0))
    ttk.Button(btns, text="OK", command=ok).pack(side="left", padx=2)
    ttk.Button(btns, text="Cancel", command=dlg.destroy).pack(side="left", padx=2)
    dlg.bind("<Return>", ok)

    dlg.show()
    return dlg.result


class App(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("Valt")
        self.geometry("680x470")
        self.minsize(580, 400)

        self.views = []          # unlocked compartment views
        self.password = None     # the password that unlocked self.views
        self.vault_path = None
        self.busy = False
        self.events = queue.Queue()
        self.track = Track("working")
        self._comp_by_item = {}

        self._build()
        self._refresh_buttons()
        self.status_var.set("Open a vault, or create a new one.")
        self.after(80, self._poll)

    # ---------- layout ----------

    def _build(self):
        pad = {"padx": 10, "pady": 6}
        self.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        self.rowconfigure(3, weight=1)

        top = ttk.Frame(self)
        top.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="ew", **pad)
        top.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)
        ttk.Label(top, text="Vault file:").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w")
        self.vault_var = tk.StringVar()
        ttk.Entry(top, textvariable=self.vault_var).grid(row=0, column=1, sticky="ew", padx=6)
        ttk.Button(top, text="Browse…", command=self.browse_vault).grid(row=0, column=2)

        btns = ttk.Frame(self)
        btns.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="ew", **pad)
        self.btn_open = ttk.Button(btns, text="Open", command=self.open_vault)
        self.btn_open.pack(side="left")
        self.btn_create = ttk.Button(btns, text="Create new vault…", command=self.start_create)
        self.btn_create.pack(side="left", padx=8)

        ttk.Separator(self).grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="ew", padx=10)
        ttk.Label(self, text="Unlocked compartments").grid(row=3, column=0, sticky="w",
                                                           padx=10, pady=(6, 0))

        self.tree = ttk.Treeview(self, columns=("size",), height=9, selectmode="browse")
        self.tree.heading("#0", text="Compartment / file")
        self.tree.heading("size", text="Size")
        self.tree.column("#0", stretch=True)
        self.tree.column("size", width=90, anchor="e", stretch=False)
        self.tree.grid(row=4, column=0, sticky="nsew", padx=10, pady=6)

        actions = ttk.Frame(self)
        actions.grid(row=5, column=0, sticky="ew", padx=10)
        self.op_buttons = {}
        for text, command in (
            ("Extract…", self.start_extract),
            ("Verify", self.start_verify),
            ("Change password…", self.start_change_pw),
            ("Add compartment…", self.start_add),
            ("Remove…", self.start_remove),
        ):
            b = ttk.Button(actions, text=text, command=command, state="disabled")
            b.pack(side="left", padx=3)
            self.op_buttons[text] = b
        self.btn_lock = ttk.Button(actions, text="Lock", command=self.lock, state="disabled")
        self.btn_lock.pack(side="right", padx=3)

        self.status_var = tk.StringVar(value="No vault open.")
        bar = ttk.Frame(self)
        bar.grid(row=6, column=0, sticky="ew", padx=10, pady=(4, 8))
        bar.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        ttk.Label(bar, textvariable=self.status_var, relief="sunken",
                  anchor="w").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="ew")

        self.action_buttons = [self.btn_open, self.btn_create, self.btn_lock,
                               *self.op_buttons.values()]

    # ---------- helpers ----------

    def browse_vault(self):
        picked = filedialog.askopenfilename(
            parent=self, title="Open vault",
            filetypes=[("Valt vault", "*.valt"), ("All files", "*.*")])
        if picked:
            self.vault_var.set(picked)

    def _set_busy(self, busy):
        state = "disabled" if busy else "normal"
        for b in self.action_buttons:
            b.configure(state=state)

    def _run(self, work, verb, on_done):
        """Runs `work(update)` in a worker thread. `update(done, total, name)`
        feeds the Track; the queue reports completion to the UI thread."""
        if self.busy:
            return
        self.busy = True
        self.track = Track(verb)
        self.events = queue.Queue()
        self._set_busy(True)
        self.status_var.set(self.track.text())

        def worker():
            try:
                work(self.track.update)
                self.events.put(("done", None))
            except FormatError:
                self.events.put(("done", "Invalid or corrupted container."))
            except InvalidTag:
                self.events.put(("done", "Invalid or corrupted container."))
            except ValueError as e:
                self.events.put(("done", str(e)))
            except Exception as e:
                self.events.put(("done", f"Unexpected error: {e}"))

        threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start()
        self._poll(on_done)

    def _poll(self, on_done):
        self.status_var.set(self.track.text())
        try:
            while True:
                kind, payload = self.events.get_nowait()
                if kind == "done":
                    self.busy = False
                    self._set_busy(False)
                    if payload:
                        self.status_var.set(payload)
                        messagebox.showerror("Valt", payload)
                    on_done()
                    return
        except queue.Empty:
            pass
        self.after(80, lambda: self._poll(on_done))

    def _show_views(self):
        self.tree.delete(*self.tree.get_children())
        self._comp_by_item = {}
        for v in self.views:
            parent = self.tree.insert("", "end", open=True,
                                      text=f"'{v['name']}' — {len(v['entries'])} file(s)")
            self._comp_by_item[parent] = v
            for e in v["entries"]:
                child = self.tree.insert(parent, "end", text="    " + e["name"],
                                         values=(human(e["size"]),))
                self._comp_by_item[child] = v

    def _selected_comp(self):
        item = self.tree.focus()
        while item:
            comp = self._comp_by_item.get(item)
            if comp:
                return comp
            item = self.tree.parent(item)
        return None

    # ---------- actions ----------

    def open_vault(self):
        path = self.vault_var.get().strip()
        if not path:
            messagebox.showinfo("Valt", "Choose a vault file first.")
            return
        pw = ask_password_dialog(self, "Unlock vault", context=os.path.basename(path))
        if pw is None:
            return

        def work(update):
            self.views = open_container(path, pw, progress=update)
            self.password = pw
            self.vault_path = path

        def done():
            self._show_views()
            self.status_var.set(f"Unlocked {len(self.views)} compartment(s).")

        self._run(work, "unlocking", done)

    def lock(self):
        self.views = []
        self.password = None
        self._show_views()
        self.status_var.set("Vault locked.")

    def start_create(self):
        dlg = CreateVaultDialog(self)
        if dlg.result is None:
            return
        path, compartments = dlg.result

        def work(update):
            create(path, compartments, progress=update)

        def done():
            self.vault_var.set(path)
            self.views = []
            self.status_var.set("✔ Vault created — use Open to unlock.")

        self._run(work, "packing", done)

    def start_extract(self):
        comp = self._selected_comp()
        if comp is None:
            messagebox.showinfo("Valt", "Unlock a compartment first, then select it.")
            return
        dest = filedialog.askdirectory(parent=self, title="Extract to folder")
        if not dest:
            return

        def work(update):
            extract_all(self.vault_path, comp["segment_offset"], comp["segment_len"],
                        comp["folder_key"], comp["index_len"], dest, progress=update)

        def done():
            self.status_var.set(f"Extracted '{comp['name']}' to '{dest}'.")

        self._run(work, "extracting", done)

    def start_verify(self):
        def work(update):
            for v in self.views:
                ok, bad = verify_compartment(self.vault_path, v["segment_offset"],
                                             v["segment_len"], v["folder_key"],
                                             v["index_len"], progress=update)
                if not ok:
                    return f"✘ '{v['name']}': corrupted at '{bad}'"
            return "✔ All unlocked compartments verified."

        self._run(work, "verifying", lambda result: self.status_var.set(result))

    def start_change_pw(self):
        comp = self._selected_comp()
        if comp is None:
            messagebox.showinfo("Valt", "Unlock a compartment first.")
            return
        new_pw = ask_new_password_dialog(self, context=comp["name"])
        if new_pw is None:
            return
        change_password(self.vault_path, self.password, new_pw, slot=comp["slot"])
        self.password = new_pw
        self.status_var.set(f"✔ Password changed for '{comp['name']}'.")

    def start_remove(self):
        comp = self._selected_comp()
        if comp is None:
            return
        if not messagebox.askyesno(
                "Valt", f"Remove '{comp['name']}' from this vault?\n\n"
                        "Old copies (backups) still contain it."):
            return
        remove(self.vault_path, self.password, comp["slot"])
        self.views = [v for v in self.views if v["slot"] != comp["slot"]]
        self._show_views()
        self.status_var.set(f"✔ Removed '{comp['name']}' from this vault.")


class CreateVaultDialog(Dialog):
    """W2 - returns (vault_path, compartments) or None."""

    def __init__(self, parent):
        super().__init__(parent, "Create vault and parameters")
        frm = self.body
        frm.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)

        ttk.Label(frm, text="Vault file:").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w")
        self.path_var = tk.StringVar()
        ttk.Entry(frm, textvariable=self.path_var, width=40).grid(row=0, column=1,
                                                                  sticky="ew", padx=6)
        ttk.Button(frm, text="Browse…", command=self.browse_save).grid(row=0, column=2)

        ttk.Label(frm, text="Folders to lock (one compartment each):").grid(
            row=1, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="w", pady=(10, 2))
        self.tree = ttk.Treeview(frm, columns=("folder",), height=5,
                                 show="tree headings", selectmode="browse")
        self.tree.heading("#0", text="Compartment label")
        self.tree.heading("folder", text="Folder")
        self.tree.column("folder", stretch=True)
        self.tree.grid(row=2, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="ew")

        rowbtns = ttk.Frame(frm)
        rowbtns.grid(row=3, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="w", pady=4)
        ttk.Button(rowbtns, text="Add folder…", command=self.add_folder).pack(side="left")
        ttk.Button(rowbtns, text="Remove selected",
                   command=self.remove_selected).pack(side="left", padx=6)

        self.rows = []          # dicts: {"folder", "password", "name"}

        ttk.Label(frm, text="Slot count is derived automatically "
                            "(compartments + 2 spares).").grid(
            row=4, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="w", pady=(8, 0))

        okc = ttk.Frame(frm)
        okc.grid(row=5, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="e", pady=(10, 0))
        ttk.Button(okc, text="OK", command=self.ok).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        ttk.Button(okc, text="Cancel", command=self.destroy).pack(side="left", padx=2)

    def browse_save(self):
        picked = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(
            parent=self, title="New vault file", defaultextension=".valt",
            filetypes=[("Valt vault", "*.valt")])
        if picked:
            self.path_var.set(picked)

    def add_folder(self):
        picked = filedialog.askdirectory(parent=self, title="Folder to lock")
        if not picked:
            return
        picked = os.path.normpath(picked)
        label = resolve_label(picked, "")            # auto from the folder name
        pw = ask_new_password_dialog(self, context=label)
        if pw is None:
            return
        self.rows.append({"folder": picked, "password": pw, "label": label})
        self.tree.insert("", "end", text=label, values=(picked,))

    def remove_selected(self):
        item = self.tree.selection()
        if item:
            index = self.tree.index(item[0])
            self.tree.delete(item[0])
            self.rows.pop(index)

    def ok(self):
        path = self.path_var.get().strip()
        if not path:
            messagebox.showinfo("Valt", "Choose a vault file first.")
            return
        if not self.rows:
            messagebox.showinfo("Valt", "Add at least one folder.")
            return
        compartments = [(r["folder"], r["password"], r["label"]) for r in self.rows]
        self.result = (path, compartments)
        self.destroy()

"""Valt GUI - a small ttk front end over the vault library.

One window per action (light theme, WinRAR-shaped but minimal): open,
create, extract, verify, change-pw, remove, add. Everything heavy runs
in a worker thread; the main thread polls a queue for progress and
results. The format layer never renders anything.
"""

import os
import queue
import threading
import time
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk, filedialog, messagebox

from cryptography.exceptions import InvalidTag

from valt.container import FormatError, read_header
from valt.safes import resolve_label
from valt.unpacker import extract_all, verify_compartment
from valt.vault import create, open_container, change_password, remove, add
from valt.cli import human, fmt_eta

CHUNK = 65536


def hide_console_if_owned():
    """When the packaged exe is double-clicked it spawns its own console;
    hide that window. Launched from a real terminal, leave it alone."""
    if os.name != "nt":
        return
    try:
        import ctypes
        kernel32 = ctypes.windll.kernel32
        user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
        buf = (ctypes.c_uint * 1)()
        if kernel32.GetConsoleProcessList(buf, 1) == 1:
            hwnd = kernel32.GetConsoleWindow()
            if hwnd:
                user32.ShowWindow(hwnd, 0)          # SW_HIDE
    except Exception:
        pass


class Track:
    """Holds the latest progress report; polled by the UI thread."""

    def __init__(self, verb):
        self.verb = verb
        self.done = 0
        self.total = 0
        self.name = None
        self.start = None

    def update(self, done, total, name=None):
        self.done, self.total = done, total
        if name is not None:
            self.name = name
        if done == 0:
            self.start = time.monotonic()           # new phase: reset the ETA clock

    def text(self):
        if not self.total:
            return self.verb
        who = f" '{self.name}'" if self.name else ""
        pct = 100 * self.done / self.total
        line = f"{self.verb}{who}: {pct:.0f}%"
        if 0 < self.done < self.total and self.start:
            eta = (time.monotonic() - self.start) * (self.total / self.done - 1)
            line += f" · ETA {fmt_eta(eta)}"
        return line


def _center(win, parent):
    win.update_idletasks()
    x = parent.winfo_rootx() + (parent.winfo_width() - win.winfo_width()) // 2
    y = parent.winfo_rooty() + (parent.winfo_height() - win.winfo_height()) // 3
    win.geometry(f"+{max(x, 0)}+{max(y, 0)}")


class Dialog(tk.Toplevel):
    """Small modal with OK/Cancel; the result lands in self.result."""

    def __init__(self, parent, title):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.title(title)
        self.transient(parent)
        self.resizable(False, False)
        self.result = None
        self.body = ttk.Frame(self, padding=12)
        self.body.grid()
        self.bind("<Escape>", lambda e: self.destroy())

    def show(self):
        self.grab_set()
        _center(self, self.master)
        self.wait_window()


def ask_password_dialog(parent, title="Unlock vault", context=None):
    dlg = Dialog(parent, title)
    frm = dlg.body
    frm.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
    text = f"Password for '{context}':" if context else "Password:"
    ttk.Label(frm, text=text).grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(0, 4))
    ent = ttk.Entry(frm, show="*", width=32)
    ent.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="ew")
    ent.focus_set()

    def ok(event=None):
        dlg.result = ent.get()
        dlg.destroy()

    btns = ttk.Frame(frm)
    btns.grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="e", pady=(10, 0))
    ttk.Button(btns, text="OK", command=ok).pack(side="left", padx=2)
    ttk.Button(btns, text="Cancel", command=dlg.destroy).pack(side="left", padx=2)
    dlg.bind("<Return>", ok)

    dlg.show()
    return dlg.result


def ask_new_password_dialog(parent, context=None):
    dlg = Dialog(parent, "Set compartment password")
    frm = dlg.body
    frm.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
    text = f"Password for '{context}':" if context else "Password:"
    ttk.Label(frm, text=text).grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(0, 4))
    e1 = ttk.Entry(frm, show="*", width=32)
    e1.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="ew")
    ttk.Label(frm, text="Confirm:").grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(6, 0))
    e2 = ttk.Entry(frm, show="*", width=32)
    e2.grid(row=3, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=(6, 0))
    msg = tk.StringVar()
    ttk.Label(frm, textvariable=msg, foreground="#a00000").grid(row=4, column=0, sticky="w")
    e1.focus_set()

    def ok(event=None):
        pw = e1.get()
        if len(pw) < 8:
            msg.set("Use at least 8 characters.")
            return
        if pw != e2.get():
            msg.set("The two passwords do not match.")
            return
        dlg.result = pw
        dlg.destroy()

    btns = ttk.Frame(frm)
    btns.grid(row=5, column=0, sticky="e", pady=(10, 0))
    ttk.Button(btns, text="OK", command=ok).pack(side="left", padx=2)
    ttk.Button(btns, text="Cancel", command=dlg.destroy).pack(side="left", padx=2)
    dlg.bind("<Return>", ok)

    dlg.show()
    return dlg.result


class App(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("Valt")
        self.geometry("680x470")
        self.minsize(580, 400)

        self.views = []          # unlocked compartment views
        self.password = None     # the password that unlocked self.views
        self.vault_path = None
        self.busy = False
        self.events = queue.Queue()
        self.track = Track("working")
        self._comp_by_item = {}

        self._build()
        self._refresh_buttons()
        self.status_var.set("Open a vault, or create a new one.")
        self.after(80, self._poll)

    # ---------- layout ----------

    def _build(self):
        pad = {"padx": 10, "pady": 6}
        self.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        self.rowconfigure(3, weight=1)

        top = ttk.Frame(self)
        top.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="ew", **pad)
        top.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)
        ttk.Label(top, text="Vault file:").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w")
        self.vault_var = tk.StringVar()
        ttk.Entry(top, textvariable=self.vault_var).grid(row=0, column=1, sticky="ew", padx=6)
        ttk.Button(top, text="Browse…", command=self.browse_vault).grid(row=0, column=2)

        btns = ttk.Frame(self)
        btns.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="ew", **pad)
        self.btn_open = ttk.Button(btns, text="Open", command=self.open_vault)
        self.btn_open.pack(side="left")
        self.btn_create = ttk.Button(btns, text="Create new vault…", command=self.start_create)
        self.btn_create.pack(side="left", padx=8)

        ttk.Separator(self).grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="ew", padx=10)
        ttk.Label(self, text="Unlocked compartments").grid(row=3, column=0, sticky="w",
                                                           padx=10, pady=(6, 0))

        self.tree = ttk.Treeview(self, columns=("size",), height=9, selectmode="browse")
        self.tree.heading("#0", text="Compartment / file")
        self.tree.heading("size", text="Size")
        self.tree.column("#0", stretch=True)
        self.tree.column("size", width=90, anchor="e", stretch=False)
        self.tree.grid(row=4, column=0, sticky="nsew", padx=10, pady=6)

        actions = ttk.Frame(self)
        actions.grid(row=5, column=0, sticky="ew", padx=10)
        self.op_buttons = {}
        for text, command in (
            ("Extract…", self.start_extract),
            ("Verify", self.start_verify),
            ("Change password…", self.start_change_pw),
            ("Add compartment…", self.start_add),
            ("Remove…", self.start_remove),
        ):
            b = ttk.Button(actions, text=text, command=command, state="disabled")
            b.pack(side="left", padx=3)
            self.op_buttons[text] = b
        self.btn_lock = ttk.Button(actions, text="Lock", command=self.lock, state="disabled")
        self.btn_lock.pack(side="right", padx=3)

        self.status_var = tk.StringVar(value="No vault open.")
        bar = ttk.Frame(self)
        bar.grid(row=6, column=0, sticky="ew", padx=10, pady=(4, 8))
        bar.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        ttk.Label(bar, textvariable=self.status_var, relief="sunken",
                  anchor="w").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="ew")

        self.action_buttons = [self.btn_open, self.btn_create, self.btn_lock,
                               *self.op_buttons.values()]

    # ---------- helpers ----------

    def browse_vault(self):
        picked = filedialog.askopenfilename(
            parent=self, title="Open vault",
            filetypes=[("Valt vault", "*.valt"), ("All files", "*.*")])
        if picked:
            self.vault_var.set(picked)

    def _set_busy(self, busy):
        state = "disabled" if busy else "normal"
        for b in self.action_buttons:
            b.configure(state=state)

    def _run(self, work, verb, on_done):
        """Runs `work(update)` in a worker thread. `update(done, total, name)`
        feeds the Track; the queue reports completion to the UI thread."""
        if self.busy:
            return
        self.busy = True
        self.track = Track(verb)
        self.events = queue.Queue()
        self._set_busy(True)
        self.status_var.set(self.track.text())

        def worker():
            try:

            except InvalidTag:

                self.events.put(("done", str(e)))
            except Exception as e:
                self.events.put(("done", f"Unexpected error: {e}"))

        self._poll(on_done)

    def _poll(self, on_done):
        self.status_var.set(self.track.text())
        try:
            while True:
                kind, payload = self.events.get_nowait()
                if kind == "done":
                    self.busy = False
                    self._set_busy(False)
                    if payload:
                        self.status_var.set(payload)
                        messagebox.showerror("Valt", payload)
                    on_done()
                    return

            pass

257:         if self.busy:

`self.after(80, self._poll)` — schedules `_poll` with no args → `_poll()` missing `on_done`.

The design flaw: `_poll` serves two purposes:
1. The idle loop: refresh status from Track (no completion handling)
2. The operation waiter: drain events and handle completion (needs on_done)

The fix: separate the concerns:
- `_poll_status()` — the always-running tick: updates the status label from Track, no on_done needed
- `_poll_events(on_done)` — the operation-specific completion waiter

Or simpler: give `_poll` a default: `def _poll(self, on_done=None)` — when called without on_done (idle tick), it just updates status and doesn't handle "done" events... but "done" events could arrive with no handler → the completion would be missed!

Cleaner fix:
1. `__init__`: `self.after(80, self._tick)` where `_tick` updates status only
2. `_run`: after starting the worker, schedule `_poll_events(on_done)` — the events-polling loop only runs while an operation is active
3. `_poll_events`: drains events; on "done" → busy=False, _set_busy(False), error handling, on_done(), _refresh_buttons(), and reschedule `_tick`; if empty → after(80, _poll_events)

## The bug

`App.__init__` ended with `self.after(80, self._poll)` — scheduling `_poll` **without the `on_done` argument** it requires. The moment the app opened, the scheduler fired it argument-less → `TypeError: missing 1 required positional argument`.

## The fix

The old `_poll` mixed two jobs, which is why it needed an argument sometimes and not others. Now they're separate:

- **No idle loop at all** — when nothing is running, nothing changes on screen, so no scheduled callback is needed. (`__init__` no longer schedules anything.)
- **`_run` starts the operation waiter**: `_poll_events(on_done)` — drains the event queue while the worker runs, and on completion: stops, re-enables buttons per the views, shows any error, calls `on_done()`, and returns. The loop only exists while an operation is active.

The dead old `_poll` (which even had a `self._refresh_buttons()` in its done path — a good idea, now preserved in `_poll_events`'s completion path) is deleted.

def do_create(args):
    print("Pick strong, unique passwords. Forgotten passwords can never be recovered.\n")

    compartments = []

    if args.folders:
        # flag mode: folders and labels come from the command line,
        # only the passwords are asked for
        if args.label and len(args.folders) > 1:
            print("--label works with exactly one --folder.")

        total = len(args.folders)

            shown = os.path.basename(os.path.normpath(folder))
            print(f"Compartment {i} of {total}: '{shown}'")
            pw = ask_password(confirm=True, for_name=shown)
            compartments.append((folder, pw, args.label or ""))
    else:
        # interactive mode: the classic loop, one compartment at a time
        while True:
            ans = input("Add a compartment? y/n: ").strip().lower()

            folder = input("Folder path: ").strip()

"""Valt GUI - a small ttk front end over the vault library.

Two tabs (light theme, WinRAR-shaped but minimal): Unlock and Create.
Everything heavy runs in a worker thread; the main thread polls a queue
for progress and results. The format layer never renders anything.
"""

import os
import queue
import threading
import time
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk, filedialog, messagebox

from cryptography.exceptions import InvalidTag

from valt.container import FormatError, read_header
from valt.safes import resolve_label
from valt.unpacker import extract_all, verify_compartment
from valt.vault import create, open_container, change_password, remove, add
from valt.cli import human, fmt_eta

CHUNK = 65536


def hide_console_if_owned():
    """When the packaged exe is double-clicked it spawns its own console;
    hide that window. Launched from a real terminal, leave it alone."""
    if os.name != "nt":
        return
    try:
        import ctypes
        kernel32 = ctypes.windll.kernel32
        user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
        buf = (ctypes.c_uint * 1)()
        if kernel32.GetConsoleProcessList(buf, 1) == 1:
            hwnd = kernel32.GetConsoleWindow()
            if hwnd:
                user32.ShowWindow(hwnd, 0)          # SW_HIDE
    except Exception:
        pass


class Track:
    """Holds the latest progress report; polled by the UI thread."""

    def __init__(self, verb):
        self.verb = verb
        self.done = 0
        self.total = 0
        self.name = None
        self.start = None

    def update(self, done, total, name=None):
        self.done, self.total = done, total
        if name is not None:
            self.name = name
        if done == 0:
            self.start = time.monotonic()           # new phase: reset the ETA clock

    def text(self):
        if not self.total:
            return self.verb
        who = f" '{self.name}'" if self.name else ""
        pct = 100 * self.done / self.total
        line = f"{self.verb}{who}: {pct:.0f}%"
        if 0 < self.done < self.total and self.start:
            eta = (time.monotonic() - self.start) * (self.total / self.done - 1)
            line += f" · ETA {fmt_eta(eta)}"
        return line


def _center(win, parent):
    win.update_idletasks()
    x = parent.winfo_rootx() + (parent.winfo_width() - win.winfo_width()) // 2
    y = parent.winfo_rooty() + (parent.winfo_height() - win.winfo_height()) // 3
    win.geometry(f"+{max(x, 0)}+{max(y, 0)}")


class Dialog(tk.Toplevel):
    """Small modal with OK/Cancel; the result lands in self.result."""

    def __init__(self, parent, title):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.title(title)
        self.transient(parent)
        self.resizable(False, False)
        self.result = None
        self.body = ttk.Frame(self, padding=12)
        self.body.grid()
        self.bind("<Escape>", lambda e: self.destroy())

    def show(self):
        self.grab_set()
        _center(self, self.master)
        self.wait_window()


def ask_new_password_dialog(parent, context=None):
    """Small modal: password + confirm, at least 8 characters.
    Returns the password, or None on cancel."""
    dlg = Dialog(parent, "Set compartment password")
    frm = dlg.body
    frm.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
    text = f"Password for '{context}':" if context else "Password:"
    ttk.Label(frm, text=text).grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(0, 4))
    e1 = ttk.Entry(frm, show="*", width=32)
    e1.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="ew")
    ttk.Label(frm, text="Confirm:").grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(6, 0))
    e2 = ttk.Entry(frm, show="*", width=32)
    e2.grid(row=3, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=(6, 0))
    msg = tk.StringVar()
    ttk.Label(frm, textvariable=msg, foreground="#a00000").grid(row=4, column=0, sticky="w")
    e1.focus_set()

    def ok(event=None):
        pw = e1.get()
        if len(pw) < 8:
            msg.set("Use at least 8 characters.")
            return
        if pw != e2.get():
            msg.set("The two passwords do not match.")
            return
        dlg.result = pw
        dlg.destroy()

    btns = ttk.Frame(frm)
    btns.grid(row=5, column=0, sticky="e", pady=(10, 0))
    ttk.Button(btns, text="OK", command=ok).pack(side="left", padx=2)
    ttk.Button(btns, text="Cancel", command=dlg.destroy).pack(side="left", padx=2)
    dlg.bind("<Return>", ok)

    dlg.show()
    return dlg.result


def ask_change_password_dialog(parent, context, old_password):
    """Small modal: old (pre-filled), new + confirm.
    Returns the new password, or None on cancel."""
    dlg = Dialog(parent, f"Change password for '{context}'")
    frm = dlg.body
    frm.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
    ttk.Label(frm, text="Current password:").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(0, 4))
    e_old = ttk.Entry(frm, show="*", width=32)
    e_old.insert(0, old_password)
    e_old.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="ew")
    ttk.Label(frm, text="New password:").grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(6, 0))
    e_new = ttk.Entry(frm, show="*", width=32)
    e_new.grid(row=3, column=0, sticky="ew")
    ttk.Label(frm, text="Confirm new password:").grid(row=4, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(6, 0))
    e_conf = ttk.Entry(frm, show="*", width=32)
    e_conf.grid(row=5, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=(6, 0))
    msg = tk.StringVar()
    ttk.Label(frm, textvariable=msg, foreground="#a00000").grid(row=6, column=0, sticky="w")

    def ok(event=None):
        new = e_new.get()
        if len(new) < 8:
            msg.set("Use at least 8 characters.")
            return
        if new != e_conf.get():
            msg.set("The two passwords do not match.")
            return
        dlg.result = new
        dlg.destroy()

    btns = ttk.Frame(frm)
    btns.grid(row=7, column=0, sticky="e", pady=(10, 0))
    ttk.Button(btns, text="OK", command=ok).pack(side="left", padx=2)
    ttk.Button(btns, text="Cancel", command=dlg.destroy).pack(side="left", padx=2)
    dlg.bind("<Return>", ok)

    dlg.show()
    return dlg.result


class App(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("Valt")
        self.geometry("680x520")
        self.minsize(600, 460)

        self.views = []              # unlocked compartment views
        self.password = None         # the password that unlocked self.views
        self.vault_path = None
        self.slot_count = None
        self.busy = False
        self.events = queue.Queue()
        self.track = Track("working")
        self._comp_by_item = {}
        self.pending = []            # create tab: staged compartments

        self._build()
        self._refresh_buttons()
        self.status_var.set("Open a vault, or create a new one.")
        self.after(80, self._poll)

    # ---------- layout ----------

    def _build(self):
        pad = {"padx": 10, "pady": 6}
        self.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        self.rowconfigure(1, weight=1)

        top = ttk.Frame(self)
        top.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="ew", **pad)
        top.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)
        ttk.Label(top, text="Vault file:").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w")
        self.vault_var = tk.StringVar()
        ttk.Entry(top, textvariable=self.vault_var).grid(row=0, column=1, sticky="ew", padx=6)
        ttk.Button(top, text="Browse…", command=self.browse_vault).grid(row=0, column=2)

        self.notebook = ttk.Notebook(self)
        self.notebook.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="nsew", **pad)

        self.tab_unlock = ttk.Frame(self.notebook)
        self.tab_create = ttk.Frame(self.notebook)
        self.notebook.add(self.tab_unlock, text="Unlock")
        self.notebook.add(self.tab_create, text="Create")

        self._build_unlock_tab(self.tab_unlock)
        self._build_create_tab(self.tab_create)

        self.status_var = tk.StringVar(value="Open a vault, or create a new one.")
        bar = ttk.Frame(self)
        bar.grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="ew", padx=10, pady=(4, 8))
        bar.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        ttk.Label(bar, textvariable=self.status_var, relief="sunken",
                  anchor="w").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="ew")

        self.action_buttons = [self.btn_unlock, self.btn_create_vault,
                               *self.op_buttons.values()]

    def _build_unlock_tab(self, tab):
        tab.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        tab.rowconfigure(1, weight=1)

        row = ttk.Frame(tab)
        row.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="ew", padx=8, pady=(8, 4))
        ttk.Label(row, text="Password:").pack(side="left")
        self.unlock_pw_var = tk.StringVar()
        e = ttk.Entry(row, textvariable=self.unlock_pw_var, show="*")
        e.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=6)
        ttk.Button(row, text="Unlock", command=self.unlock_vault).pack(side="left")
        e.bind("<Return>", lambda event: self.unlock_vault())

        self.tree = ttk.Treeview(tab, columns=("size",), height=9, selectmode="browse")
        self.tree.heading("#0", text="Compartment / file")
        self.tree.heading("size", text="Size")
        self.tree.column("#0", stretch=True)
        self.tree.column("size", width=90, anchor="e", stretch=False)
        self.tree.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="nsew", padx=8, pady=4)

        actions = ttk.Frame(tab)
        actions.grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="ew", padx=8, pady=4)
        self.op_buttons = {}
        for text, command in (
            ("Extract…", self.start_extract),
            ("Verify", self.start_verify),
            ("Change password…", self.start_change_pw),
            ("Remove…", self.start_remove),
        ):
            b = ttk.Button(actions, text=text, command=command, state="disabled")
            b.pack(side="left", padx=3)
            self.op_buttons[text] = b
        self.btn_lock = ttk.Button(actions, text="Lock", command=self.lock, state="disabled")
        self.btn_lock.pack(side="right", padx=3)

    def _build_create_tab(self, tab):
        tab.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        tab.rowconfigure(1, weight=1)

        row = ttk.Frame(tab)
        row.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="ew", padx=8, pady=(8, 4))
        ttk.Label(row, text="Folder to lock:").pack(side="left")
        self.folder_var = tk.StringVar()
        fe = ttk.Entry(row, textvariable=self.folder_var)
        fe.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=6)
        ttk.Button(row, text="Browse…", command=self.browse_folder).pack(side="left")
        ttk.Label(row, text="Label (optional):").pack(side="left", padx=(10, 0))
        self.label_var = tk.StringVar()
        le = ttk.Entry(row, textvariable=self.label_var, width=22)
        le.pack(side="left", padx=6)

        ttk.Button(tab, text="Lock this folder into the vault",
                   command=self.pack_folder).grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="w",
                                                  padx=8, pady=4)
        ttk.Label(tab, text="asks for the compartment's password").grid(
            row=2, column=0, sticky="w", padx=8)

        self.rows_tree = ttk.Treeview(tab, columns=("folder",), height=5,
                                      show="tree headings", selectmode="browse")
        self.rows_tree.heading("#0", text="Compartment label")
        self.rows_tree.heading("folder", text="Folder")
        self.rows_tree.column("folder", stretch=True)
        self.rows_tree.grid(row=3, column=0, sticky="nsew", padx=8, pady=4)

    # ---------- helpers ----------

    def browse_vault(self):
        picked = filedialog.askopenfilename(
            parent=self, title="Open vault",
            filetypes=[("Valt vault", "*.valt"), ("All files", "*.*")])
        if picked:
            self.vault_var.set(picked)

    def browse_folder(self):
        picked = filedialog.askdirectory(parent=self, title="Folder to lock")
        if picked:
            self.folder_var.set(os.path.normpath(picked))

    def _set_busy(self, busy):
        state = "disabled" if busy else "normal"
        for b in self.action_buttons:
            b.configure(state=state)

    def _run(self, work, verb, on_done):
        """Runs `work(update)` in a worker thread. `update(done, total, name)`
        feeds the Track; the queue reports completion to the UI thread."""
        if self.busy:
            return
        self.busy = True
        self.track = Track(verb)
        self.events = queue.Queue()
        self._set_busy(True)
        self.status_var.set(self.track.text())

        def worker():
            try:
                work(self.track.update)
                self.events.put(("done", None))
            except FormatError:
                self.events.put(("done", "Invalid or corrupted container."))
            except InvalidTag:
                self.events.put(("done", "Invalid or corrupted container."))
            except ValueError as e:
                self.events.put(("done", str(e)))
            except Exception as e:
                self.events.put(("done", f"Unexpected error: {e}"))

        threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start()
        self._poll(on_done)

    def _poll(self, on_done):
        self.status_var.set(self.track.text())
        try:
            while True:
                kind, payload = self.events.get_nowait()
                if kind == "done":
                    self.busy = False
                    self._set_busy(False)
                    if payload:
                        self.status_var.set(payload)
                        messagebox.showerror("Valt", payload)
                    on_done()
                    return
        except queue.Empty:
            pass
        self.after(80, lambda: self._poll(on_done))

    def _show_views(self):
        self.tree.delete(*self.tree.get_children())
        self._comp_by_item = {}
        for v in self.views:
            parent = self.tree.insert("", "end", open=True,
                                      text=f"'{v['name']}' — {len(v['entries'])} file(s)")
            self._comp_by_item[parent] = v
            for e in v["entries"]:
                child = self.tree.insert(parent, "end", text="    " + e["name"],
                                         values=(human(e["size"]),))
                self._comp_by_item[child] = v

    def _selected_comp(self):
        item = self.tree.focus()
        while item:
            comp = self._comp_by_item.get(item)
            if comp:
                return comp
            item = self.tree.parent(item)
        return None

    # ---------- actions ----------

    def open_vault(self):
        path = self.vault_var.get().strip()
        if not path:
            messagebox.showinfo("Valt", "Choose a vault file first.")
            return
        pw = ask_password_dialog(self, "Unlock vault", context=os.path.basename(path))
        if pw is None:
            return

        def work(update):
            self.views = open_container(path, pw, progress=update)
            for v in self.views:
                v["password"] = pw          # in-memory only (P7): each view knows its own
            self.vault_path = path
            slot_count, data_offset = read_header(path)
            self.slot_count = slot_count

        def done():
            self._show_views()
            self.status_var.set(f"Unlocked {len(self.views)} compartment(s).")

        self._run(work, "unlocking", done)

    def lock(self):
        self.views = []
        self.password = None
        self._show_views()
        self._refresh_buttons()
        self.status_var.set("Vault locked.")

    def start_create(self):
        dlg = CreateVaultDialog(self)
        if dlg.result is None:
            return
        path, compartments = dlg.result

        def work(update):
            create(path, compartments, progress=update)

        def done():
            self.vault_var.set(path)
            self.views = []
            self.status_var.set("✔ Vault created — use Open to unlock.")

            messagebox.showinfo("Valt", "Unlock a compartment first, then select it.")
            return
        dest = filedialog.askdirectory(parent=self, title="Extract to folder")
        if not dest:
            return

        def work(update):
            extract_all(self.vault_path, comp["segment_offset"], comp["segment_len"],
                        comp["folder_key"], comp["index_len"], dest, progress=update)

        def done():
            self.status_var.set(f"Extracted '{comp['name']}' to '{dest}'.")

        self._run(work, "extracting", done)

    def start_verify(self):
        def work(update):
            for v in self.views:
                ok, bad = verify_compartment(self.vault_path, v["segment_offset"],
                                             v["segment_len"], v["folder_key"],
                                             v["index_len"], progress=update)
                if not ok:
                    return f"✘ '{v['name']}': corrupted at '{bad}'"
            return "✔ All unlocked compartments verified."

        self._run(work, "verifying", lambda result: self.status_var.set(result))

    def start_change_pw(self):
        comp = self._selected_comp()
        if comp is None:
            messagebox.showinfo("Valt", "Unlock a compartment first.")
            return
        new_pw = ask_new_password_dialog(self, context=comp["name"])
        if new_pw is None:
            return
        change_password(self.vault_path, comp["password"], new_pw, slot=comp["slot"])
        comp["password"] = new_pw

        comp = self._selected_comp()
        if comp is None:

            return
        if not messagebox.askyesno(

        remove(self.vault_path, comp["password"], comp["slot"])

        self._show_views()
        self.status_var.set(f"✔ Removed '{comp['name']}' from this vault.")

def browse_folder(self):
        picked = filedialog.askdirectory(parent=self, title="Folder to lock")
        if picked:
            self.folder_var.set(os.path.normpath(picked))

    def pack_folder(self):
        """The Create tab's action: locks the staged folder into the vault.
        Creates the vault on first use, appends afterwards."""
        folder = self.folder_var.get().strip()
        if not folder or not os.path.isdir(folder):
            messagebox.showinfo("Valt", "Choose a valid folder first.")
            return
        label = resolve_label(folder, self.label_var.get().strip())

        # the vault: create on first use, append afterwards
        if self.vault_path and os.path.exists(self.vault_path):
            slot_count, data_offset = read_header(self.vault_path)
            used = {v["slot"] for v in self.views}
            free = [i for i in range(slot_count) if i not in used]
            if not free:
                messagebox.showinfo("Valt", "All slots are occupied in this vault.")
                return
            slot = free[0]
            if not messagebox.askyesno(
                    "Valt", "You cannot see which slots are secretly occupied. If the "
                    "slot chosen holds a compartment whose password you have "
                    "forgotten, writing here destroys it.\n\nLock this folder in "
                    f"slot {slot}?"):
                return
            pw = ask_new_password_dialog(self, context=label)
            if pw is None:
                return

            def work(update):
                add(self.vault_path, folder, pw, label, slot=slot, progress=update)

            def done():
                self.folder_var.set("")
                self.label_var.set("")
                self.status_var.set(f"✔ Added '{label}' in slot {slot}.")
            self._run(work, "packing", done)
        else:
            # a new vault: the path must be set (or default next to the folder)
            if not self.vault_path:
                self.vault_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(folder) or ".", "my.valt")
                self.vault_var.set(self.vault_path)
            slot_count = 3                      # 1 compartment + 2 spares
            pw = ask_new_password_dialog(self, context=label)
            if pw is None:
                return

            def work(update):
                create(self.vault_path, [(folder, pw, label)], slots=slot_count,
                       progress=update)

            def done():
                self.folder_var.set("")
                self.label_var.set("")
                self.status_var.set(f"✔ Vault created at '{self.vault_path}'.")
            self._run(work, "packing", done)
